geometry.substrate: Explicit 200nm displayed n+Si slice with backside assumed tied to gate; not measured wafer thickness.

contacts.warning: Effective 0.15eV electron barrier sensitivity with SURF.REC; default Richardson emission coefficient is an unvalidated prior, not a measured Pd/IWO property.

mobility.warning: Constant band-mobility initialization. ATLAS DOS partitions free/trapped carriers; do not multiply again by paper Eq5. Eq6 roughness needs native implementation and sensitivity verification.

calibration.note: 5x off-band median defines a weighting region, NOT an instrument detection limit. No current offset is added to ATLAS results.

provenance.dimensions: User screenshot and main paper Section 2.1; contact_length_um is an explicit unknown seed.
provenance.current_units: A/um inferred from screenshot; Excel headers do not state units.
provenance.temperature: 300 K working assumption; measurement temperature not recorded in workbook.
provenance.eps_hfo2_and_iwo: 2026 Supporting Information Figure S1: HfO2 19.57 +/-0.06 and IWO 9.30 +/-0.04.
provenance.eps_al2o3: 9.0 explicit provisional assumption, not reported measurement in supplied main paper.
provenance.eg_and_affinity: Prior from a DIFFERENT IWO study, Fan et al. Nanomaterials 2021, 11,3070, Section 3: Eg=3.05 eV; affinity estimate4.30eV. Not measured for this 2026 sample.
provenance.all_other_electronic_values: UNFITTED engineering seeds. No trap density or mobility claimed to be a uniquely extracted physical parameter.
provenance.microscopic_mobility: Seed band mobility is not the already trap-reduced measured field-effect mobility; free/trapped partition enters through ATLAS DOS, not a second multiplicative partition.

process.channel: Pulsed DC sputtering, geometry deposition approximation only

paper_traps.prior_note: Oxygen donor+deep acceptor forms supported by 2021; numerical seeds not 2026 measurements. Native interface Gaussian uses explicit MAX.GAUSSIAN peak convention. Background ND is residual shallow donor term, not repeated VO count. Back surface disabled absent identifiable evidence.
